text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's often forgotten, but there is one 
crucial truth. Indeed..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Racewear—is not for the Umamusume alone.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I believe we have all sizes in 
stock. That one...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Tokyo Daishoten. Heading towards the 
final showdown of the year—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
An orange jacket?! Trainer, that outfit 
is...
choice_data_list: This is the racing outfit for today.
This is the racing outfit for today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The orange gates we walked through 
together on that day Copano Rickey made 
her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to share in those fond memories, I 
decided to show up wearing clothes of the 
same color.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for going out of your way☆ But how 
did you know that orange is my lucky color 
today?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A mere coincidence. But today, the two of 
them are sharp enough to predict even 
coincidences like that."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I've been thinking a lot 
about this, and...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae is strong, isn't she? And 
Acute-san, too. And me as well. We're all 
just as strong.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Don't you think so?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's what I think, but...
Yeah, I think so too, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. All three of us gathered here 
today are phenomenally strong.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Right. That's why I...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have to win today. Just keeping up 
side-by-side isn't good enough.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We can't fulfill our dreams if the three 
of us stay tied side-by-side.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head out. Those two are 
waiting for us. And so is everyone 
cheering us on!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There you are, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Tarumae, Acute-san. Something just 
crossed my mind..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae took a short break this year, 
right? It looked like a pinch at first 
glance, but with enough time...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I bet she was able to bounce back. After 
all, she's plenty tough."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Yeah, maybe it is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And Acute-san is strong too. She's been 
fighting hard at the top level for a long 
time now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And—running with the two of them makes me 
strong too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"So as things stand right now, I feel like 
I haven't proven anything yet."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ricky-chan, what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Because with my feng shui powers, if I do 
the exact same thing as the two of them, I 
wouldn't be demonstrating my power, would 
I?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Only when you can overcome two opponents 
who are just as strong will people truly 
begin to believe in feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To someone... who is just a little weaker 
than us.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just a little lacking in courage, an 
unreachable future, an unfulfilled dream. 
But with a push from feng shui—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—To make them believe... that maybe, just 
maybe, it's within reach...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I cannot settle for merely being on equal 
footing. I must push even further into the 
center of the force field.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From the Bagua to the Four Symbols. From 
the Four Symbols to the Yin and Yang. And 
in this race—from the Yin and Yang to the 
Taiji.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Once I become the undisputed, strongest 
dirt champion, that's when people will 
finally believe that "Feng Shui can 
definitely make you happy!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must win against both of them no matter 
what. I finally understood why Copano 
Rickey felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And now, the stage is set. Both Tarumae 
and Acute-san are in top form. The stands 
are packed with fans.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"This Tokyo Daishoten embodies the 
ultimate form sought by Feng Shui. If I 
can win in this environment—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely prove it! The unshakable 
power of Feng Shui!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-chan. So you've been diligently 
preparing day by day just for this 
moment~?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I mean. But if 
everyone simply walked the righteous path 
without straying—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The atmosphere is something that gets 
built up. And there is only value in 
giving it your all right then and there."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, Acute-san, please come at me with 
everything you've got today. Because 
defeating both of you—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to surpass them head-on! With the 
power of feng shui, shining at the end of 
everything I have built up!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey... Yeah, I won't lose. I won't 
lose! I'm not handing over the title of 
dirt champion. But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This confidence and intensity—is that 
really Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly the incarnation of the noble 
Azure Dragon. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the qi reaches its absolute peak, 
blue turns to yellow. Will the dragon's 
whinny—truly roar all the way to the 
heavens?
